strings.name: Zhang Ziyi
strings.summary: Zhang moved from dance to dramatic acting, breaking through in The Road Home and gaining international recognition in Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon. Hero, 2046, Memoirs of a Geisha and The Grandmaster developed her range through collaborations with Chinese-language directors. She later directed a film segment and continued exploring complex women in works including She's Got No Name.

strings.influence.rationale: Built international influence through Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon and The Grandmaster, connecting Chinese-language cinema, action and global markets.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Attended the Beijing Dance Academy's affiliated school and entered the Central Academy of Drama in 1996.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Wuxia reaches world audiences
strings.highlights.h1.text: Connected action cinema and international audiences through Crouching Tiger, Hero and House of Flying Daggers.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Performance in The Grandmaster
strings.highlights.h2.text: Undertook lengthy martial-arts preparation for Gong Er, receiving multiple film awards.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Hong Kong masterclass and honor
strings.timeline.t1.text: Discussed role preparation at the Asian Film Awards and received the Excellence in Asian Cinema Award.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Cannes presentation
strings.timeline.t2.text: Starred in Peter Chan's historical film She's Got No Name, screened out of competition.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Entered film directing
strings.timeline.t3.text: Directed and acted in the Poetry segment of My Country, My Parents.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Appeared in The Grandmaster
strings.timeline.t4.text: Played Gong Er in Wong Kar-wai's film, combining physical training with restrained emotion.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Starred in Memoirs of a Geisha
strings.timeline.t5.text: Played Sayuri in the English-language film, earning Golden Globe and BAFTA nominations.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Appeared in Crouching Tiger
strings.timeline.t6.text: Played Jen Yu in Ang Lee's wuxia film and gained wide international recognition.
strings.timeline.t7.title: The Road Home released
strings.timeline.t7.text: Zhang Yimou's film became an early breakthrough and later brought a Hundred Flowers Award.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Entered drama school
strings.timeline.t8.text: Moved from dance into systematic acting studies and began television-film work.
